QuestInfo.name: Mr. Do's Suspicious Potion 1
QuestInfo.0: Mr. Do in Mu Lung is giving you a very affectionate greeting. Uh oh, something's not right... Well, you should talk to him anyway.
QuestInfo.1: Mr. Do wanted Alpha and Beta to test a strange potion. It smelled kind of funny, but whatever. Bottoms up!
QuestInfo.2: Mr. Do's potion turned Alpha and Beta into a Bellflower!

0.0: Hey, #h0#! Where are you off to in such a hurry? Come down to the lab, hang out for a while!

yes.0: I recently made something great. It's this potion that makes you SUPER smart when you drink it. It took SO long to make, and I had to inhale a LOT of fumes, so you basically look like a purple dinosaur right now.
yes.1: Hey, hey, hey... shhh... There are no secrets between you and me. We're better than that. I'm going to give you this #rpotion#k as a gift. No, no, no. Shhh... just drink it.

no.0: I guess I'll just go back to my solitude...

default.0: Hey... Don't be afraid. Just drink it... Drink it!
